date: G1 calculation input; derived from canonical BOM/netlist and explicit assumptions

classes.name: Default
classes.purpose: Unclassified signal fallback; must not carry a power trunk.

classes.name: INPUT_POWER
classes.purpose: Input continuous routing envelope; not fuse clearing/fault approval.

classes.name: BUS_POWER
classes.purpose: Common 11V trunk and power-return equivalent cross-section. GND plane preferred; analog taps are exceptions.
classes.g1_current_basis: 7.5 A total capacity target; measured load not available

classes.name: PHASE_POWER
classes.purpose: Per-phase routing envelope; switch copper localized. ISNS IC branch is Kelvin, not a 3.5mm sense trace.
classes.g1_current_basis: calculated phase peak; conservative continuous routing screen

classes.name: O1_POWER
classes.purpose: Routing envelope only. Does not assign O1 load, change RILIM, or guarantee current limit.
classes.g1_current_basis: individual full-capacity branch envelope because port split is unmeasured; not simultaneous with S2E

classes.name: S2E_POWER
classes.purpose: S2E routing envelope; current limit and real start load require validation.
classes.g1_current_basis: individual full-capacity branch envelope because port split is unmeasured; not simultaneous with O1

classes.name: AUX_LOCAL
classes.purpose: Local bypass/bootstrap/gate branches; selected RMS routing envelope, peak pulse behavior not certified. Keep bootstrap and charge-pump loops very short.
classes.g1_current_basis: Existing diagnostic plan envelope retained; not re-qualified in G1.

classes.name: CONTROL_SENSE
classes.purpose: Low-current analog/control traces; Kelvin branches from power nets must use manual narrow escape and documented connection point.
classes.g1_current_basis: Existing diagnostic plan envelope retained; not re-qualified in G1.

classes.name: NC_DO_NOT_ROUTE
classes.purpose: Intentionally NC; class name is guidance, not a routing prohibition enforced by KiCad.
